title: The funnel, poured
description: each strip's width = people at that stage · threads trickle down · Q2 2026 cohort

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered stage names and nonnegative whole person counts. Strip width is relative to the largest available stage, and ticks retain the original nearest-40-person rounding. Missing stages do not create threads or conversion rates; a zero denominator makes the rate unavailable.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
